TS0410001.message: Chain {chain} is still being read by: {pipelines}.
TS0410001.solution: Stop or pause every pipeline listed, then write the position back; moving it under a running read changes nothing now and everything at the next start.

TS0410002.message: Pipeline {pipeline} does not read chain {chain}; it reads: {known}.
TS0410002.solution: Copy the chainId from what `position` printed for this pipeline, unedited.

TS0410003.message: Field {field} on chain {chain} is a reading, not a setting.
TS0410003.solution: Change only resumeFrom.token and send the rest back as it was printed.

TS0410004.message: Nothing to write back for pipeline {pipeline}.
TS0410004.solution: Set resumeFrom.token on the chain you mean to move; a document sent back unchanged asks for no move.
